authored_from: Articles (Serious)/technical/3B1B — Events and Time - Formal Execution.md, §III, §VI and §VII
note: SPEC vectors. The reference engine orders by a per-sustain sequence number, which is correct on one device and cannot merge two. These record the article's model: order on event time with a replica-agnostic tie-break, dedupe on stable id, and a last-writer-wins join that converges.

ordering_cases.name: ordered_by_when_it_happened_not_when_it_arrived
ordering_cases.why: §I: the world happens before the system hears about it, by unequal delays. A fact sent at 14:02 can land after its neighbour sent at 14:05.

ordering_cases.name: a_tie_on_physical_time_breaks_identically_everywhere
ordering_cases.why: §VII: on physical event time alone two distinct observations with equal t_event leave neither dominating, and the operation stops commuting. Lamport's tie-break orders on (t_event, id).

ordering_cases.name: two_offline_devices_converge_on_one_order
ordering_cases.why: The reason for event-time ordering at all: a phone and a laptop that were both offline must agree once they reconnect.

ordering_cases.name: a_repeated_id_is_dropped_not_raised_on
ordering_cases.why: §VI: the same fact WILL arrive twice, because the only reliable delivery is retry. at-least-once delivery composed with idempotent apply gives exactly-once EFFECT.

ordering_cases.name: delivering_everything_three_times_changes_nothing
ordering_cases.why: Exactly-once effect is the only thing anyone wanted; exactly-once delivery is not achievable.

causality_cases.name: a_declared_cause_outranks_a_clock
causality_cases.why: §VII: physical timestamps do not order events across devices, because clocks disagree. The ordering that survives is happens-before.

causality_cases.name: same_node_order_implies_causality
causality_cases.why: a → b if a and b are on the same node with a first.

causality_cases.name: concurrency_is_a_real_answer
causality_cases.why: Events unordered by happens-before are concurrent. That is a finding, not a gap — it is what makes a genuine conflict detectable.

convergence_cases.name: last_writer_wins_on_event_time
convergence_cases.why: §VII: a snapshot-valued dimension is a last-writer-wins register keyed on event time — a state-based CRDT.

convergence_cases.name: replicas_converge_whatever_order_they_saw_things_in
convergence_cases.why: The join is commutative, associative and idempotent, so every replica lands on the same value regardless of arrival order.

convergence_cases.name: a_tie_resolves_the_same_way_on_every_replica
convergence_cases.why: Equal event times are broken by id, so convergence does not depend on who merged first.
